parts.name: Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the flush button of the toilet, typically made of durable plastic and located on the top of the tank.
parts.Functional_description: It activates the flushing mechanism, releasing water from the tank into the bowl to clean it.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically or pivots slightly when pressed to trigger the flush valve.

parts.name: Seat
parts.Basic_description: This is the toilet seat, made of polypropylene plastic, designed for comfort and hygiene.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a comfortable sitting surface and can be lifted or lowered as needed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about hinges at the rear, allowing it to open and close.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the toilet, made of glazed ceramic, forming the bowl and tank structure.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the seat, holds water, and channels waste to the plumbing system.
parts.Movement_description: It is a fixed, non-moving structural component anchored to the floor.
